title: NetworkLayoutChangedPayload
description: network.layout.changed v1 (OpenVibe.Network server/layouts, written into network_event_outbox in the transaction that changes a stored layout). One event per change to one person's ui.layout@1: set active, saved, renamed, deleted, shared, unshared, published to the gallery, unpublished, copied from the gallery, or reset to the default. Envelope: subject { type: user, id } and the layout's revision, actor the person, visibility internal. The payload carries no account data and no layout contents, so an open page can announce a change and refetch with the person's own token.
